name: OmaSpaceTor
author: kauanmassuia14
description: Independent, colorful workspaces for every monitor.

barWidget.description: Monitor-aware workspaces with custom labels, aliases, and colors.

schema.label: Workspaces per monitor
schema.description: Number of workspace slots on each monitor. Slot 10 uses Super+0.

schema.label: Automatic monitor labels
schema.description: Use NB/M1, Notebook/Monitor 1, or the output name. Custom labels take priority.

schema.label: Monitor labels (JSON)
schema.description: Map Hyprland output names to short labels, e.g. {"eDP-1":"NB","DP-1":"EXT"}.

schema.label: Monitor color palette
schema.description: Choose a palette; assign exact colors to outputs with monitorColors.

schema.label: Monitor colors (JSON)
schema.description: Map output names to custom #RRGGBB colors, e.g. {"eDP-1":"#89B4FA"}.

schema.label: Workspace labels (JSON)
schema.description: Map slot numbers to names, e.g. {"1":"DEV","2":"WEB"}. Keyboard shortcuts still use numbers.
